    EA FC 26 Paris SG

    UT 26 Paris SG Players

    Paris SG's squad in EA FC 26 Ultimate Team consist of 185 players with 12 goalkeepers, 50 defenders, 60 midfielders and 63 attackers from a total of 23 nations. The team includes 114 Special cards, 31 Gold Rare, 17 Gold Non Rare, 7 Silver Rare, 9 Silver Non Rare, 2 Bronze Rare and 5 Bronze Non Rare cards. The average player rating including special cards is 85 with the highest rated card being Fabián Ruiz Peña with 99 rating. The combined price of all Paris SG players is 25,123,50027,490,800
